## Current View

_Not yet assessed. Run `/research <commodity topic>` to build out this view._

## Analytical Framework

Supply/demand balance → marginal cost of production → macro sensitivity → geopolitical risk premium → CFTC positioning.
Key sources: EIA, CFTC COT, LME/CME, World Gold Council, USDA WASDE.

## Active Themes

- Copper: energy transition demand vs. near-term supply constraints.
- Gold: central bank buying + real yield trajectory.
- Oil: OPEC+ discipline vs. US shale growth.
- Agricultural: La Niña / El Niño crop impact.

## Key Indicators to Track

- WTI / Brent spread (domestic vs. international crude).
- Copper/Gold ratio (global growth proxy — rising = optimistic).
- Backwardation/contango structure (backwardation = tight physical supply).
- DXY (inverse relationship with USD-denominated commodities).
- China Caixin PMI (marginal demand driver for base metals).
